Rematerialization decisions of checkpoint policies

Source: R/lax_extra.R
remat_policy_values.Rd

Ports of jax.ad_checkpoint.Saveable, Recompute and Offloadable, the values a policy of checkpoint() may return besides TRUE and FALSE: save the value, recompute it, or offload it from memory space src to dst (jaxR has one memory space, so offloading saves). Saveable and Offloadable() count as TRUE and Recompute as FALSE (they are classed logical values).

Usage

Saveable

Recompute

Offloadable(src, dst)

Format

Saveable and Recompute are classed logical scalars.

Arguments

src, dst

Memory kinds (for example "device" and "pinned_host").

Examples

policy <- function(prim, params) if (prim == "sin") Saveable else Recompute
f <- checkpoint(function(x) sin(sin(x)), policy = policy)
